patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Reply.io and RocketReach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Reply.io and RocketReach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Reply.io only if your buying job matches “AI sales engagement platform for multichannel outbound across email, LinkedIn, calls, SMS,” rather than RocketReach's shape. Choose RocketReach only if your buying job matches “B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phone numbers, and company insights ” rather than Reply.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Reply.io leans sales-engagement, email-outreach; RocketReach leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Reply.io and RocketReach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Reply.io is AI sales engagement platform for multichannel outbound across email, LinkedIn, calls, SMS, and WhatsApp with built-in B2B data.; RocketReach is B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phone numbers, and company insights with prospecting automations..
- Workflow coverage skew: Reply.io-leaning sales-engagement, email-outreach vs RocketReach-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Reply.io — none listed; RocketReach — Not a CRM pipeline/deal manager..
